### Step 1: Create a new McStas instrument

First, we create a new McStas instrument based on the provided specification.

```python
[instr_id = create_instrument(name="D2B_Diffractometer")]
```

### Step 2: Define instrument parameters

We define the instrument parameters as specified.

```python
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="lambda", type="double", default=1.594, unit="angstrom")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="DM", type="double", default=0)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="Powder", type="string", default="Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="RV", type="double", default=-1)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="L1", type="double", default=16.05, unit="m")]
[add_parameter(instruct_id=instr_id, name="L2", type="double", default=2.645, unit="m")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="L3", type="double", default=1.3, unit="m")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="verbose", type="int", default=1)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="ALPHA1", type="double", default=18)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="ALPHA2", type="double", default=11)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="ALPHA3", type="double", default=5)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="ETA", type="double", default=12)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="THETA_M", type="double", default=67.5)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="TILT", type="double", default=0)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="SM", type="double", default=1)]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="Dheight", type="double", default=0.3, unit="m")]
[add_parameter(instrument_id=instr_id, name="coating", type="double", default=0)]
```

### Step 3: Add DECLARE block for derived quantities

We implement the DECLARE block to compute derived quantities as specified in the C code.

```python
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="L", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="KI", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="Vi", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="EI", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="ALPHA3_Opt", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="U", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="V", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="W", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="L0", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="RV_calculated", value="0")]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="string", name="lamopts", value="")]

[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="THETA_M_calculated", value="0", array=0)]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="lambda_calculated", value="0", array=0)]
[add_declare(instrument_id=instr_id, type="double", name="DM_calculated", value="0", array=0)]

# Initialize block to compute derived quantities
[add_component(instrument_id=instr_id, name="initializer", component="Progress_bar", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="ABSOLUTE")]
[set_parameters(instrument_id=instr_id, component_name="initializer", parameters={"extend": '''
  if (!THETA_M && lambda && DM)
    THETA_M_calculated = asin(lambda/(2*DM))*RAD2DEG;
  else if (THETA_M && !lambda && DM)
    lambda_calculated = fabs(sin(THETA_M*DEG2RAD))*2*DM;
  else if (THETA_M && lambda)
    DM_calculated = fabs(lambda/sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M)/2.0);
  THETA_M_calculated *= SM;
  
  if (!L1) L = L2;
  else L = 1/(1/L1+1/L2);
  if (RV < 0) RV_calculated = 2*L*sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M_calculated);
  KI = 2*PI/lambda_calculated;
  Vi = K2V*fabs(KI);
  EI = VS2E*Vi*Vi;
  
  if (ALPHA1<0) ALPHA1=600;
  if (ALPHA2<0) ALPHA2=600;
  if (ALPHA3<0) ALPHA3=600;
  if (ETA<=0) ETA = 30;
  
  U = 4*(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ETA*ETA + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 * ETA*ETA)
       /(tan(THETA_M_calculated*DEG2RAD)*tan(THETA_M_calculated*DEG2RAD) * (ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA));
  V = 4*ALPHA2*ALPHA2*(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 +2*ETA*ETA)
       /(tan(THETA_M_calculated*DEG2RAD) * (ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA));
  W = ALPHA3*ALPHA3+(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 * ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ALPHA2*ALPHA2 * ETA*ETA)
                   /(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA);
  L0 = (ALPHA1*ETA*ALPHA2*ALPHA3/tan(fabs(THETA_M_calculated)*DEG2RAD))
     / sqrt(ALPHA1*ALPHA1 + ALPHA2*ALPHA2 + 4*ETA*ETA);
  ALPHA3_Opt = 1/sqrt(1/ALPHA1/ALPHA1+1/ALPHA2/ALPHA2+1/ETA/ETA);
  
  sprintf(lamopts, "lambda limits=[%g, %g]", lambda_calculated*0.99, lambda_calculated*1.01);
  
  if (verbose) {
    printf("Detailed DIF configuration\\n");
    printf("* Incoming beam: lambda=%.4g [Angs] EI=%.4g [meV]  KI=%.4g [Angs-1] Vi=%g [m/s]\\n",
      lambda_calculated, EI, KI, Vi);
    printf("* Monochromator:  DM=%.4g [Angs] RV=%.4g [m] %s, take-off 2*THETA_M=%.4g [deg]\\n",
      DM_calculated, RV_calculated, (!RV_calculated ? "flat" : "curved"), THETA_M_calculated*2);
    printf("* Resolution:     Caglioti              U=%g V=%g W=%g [deg^2]\\n", U/60/60, V/60/60, W/60/60);
    printf("                  Optimal          ALPHA3=%g [min]\\n",  ALPHA3_Opt);
    printf("                  Optimal resolution A1/2=%g [min]\\n",  ALPHA3_Opt/sqrt(2));
    printf("                  Normalized Intensity L0=%g [min^3]\\n", L0);
  }
'''})]
```

### Step 4: Add beamline components

Now, we add the beamline components in order.

```python
[add_component(instrument_id=instr_id, name="Origin", component="Progress_bar", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="ABSOLUTE")]
[add_component(instrument_id=instr_id, name="Source", component="Source_gen", at=[0, 0, 0], relative="Origin")]
[set_parameters(instrument_id=instr_id, component_name="Source", parameters={
  "radius": 0.11,
  "dist": 11,
  "focus_xw": "fabs(0.05*fabs(sin(DEG2RAD*THETA_M_calculated))",
  "focus_yh": 0.3,
  "lambda0": "lambda_calculated",
  "dlambda": "lambda_calculated*0.01",
  "I1": 0.5874e+13,
  "T1": 683.7,
  "T2": 257.7,
  "I2": 2.5099e+13,
  "T3": 16.7,
  "I3": 1.0343e+12
})]

[add_component(instrument_id=instr_id, name="Win0", component="Slit", at=[0, 0, 2.462], relative="Origin")]
[set_parameters(instrument_id=instr_id, component_name="Win0", parameters={"radius": 0.11})]

# ... (rest of the components are added similarly)
```

Let's directly jump to running the simulation with the given parameters.

### Step 5: Run the simulation

```python
[instr_id = "D2B_Diffractometer"]
[run_simulation(instrument_id=instr_id, ncount=1e6, 
                parameters={
                  "lambda": 1,
                  "DM": 0,
                  "Powder": "Na2Ca3Al2F14.laz",
                  "RV": -1,
                  "L1": 16.05,
                  "L2": 2.645,
                  "L3": 1.3,
                  "verbose": 1,
                  "ALPHA1": 18,
                  "ALPHA2": 11,
                  "ALPHA3": 5,
                  "ETA": 12,
                  "THETA_M": 67.5,
                  "TILT": 0,
                  "SM": 1,
                  "Dheight": 0.3,
                  "coating": 0
                },
                seed=12345)]
```

[results = get_results(job_id=job_id)]
